name: Top Bar Dock
author: hogar1977
description: Pinned launcher dock + running-window taskbar in one Omarchy bar widget: left-click launches/minimizes/restores, middle-drag reorders pins, right-click opens a context menu, hover shows a live window preview. Fully themed, gap-aware, web-app and Steam aware.

barWidget.description: Running apps plus a pinnable launcher dock, combined into one widget.

schema.label: Max window title length
schema.description: Titles longer than this are truncated with an ellipsis wherever a chip's title is shown.

schema.label: Hover preview delay (ms)
schema.description: How long to hover a chip before its live preview thumbnail appears.
